answer: A seat earns only for work matched to independently verified clients, and no single client may supply more than a sliver of a seat's epoch volume. A sybil cluster cannot route work to itself: self-matched volume is discarded and shared funding is traceable, so every clone needs fresh genuine counterparties. Getting them grows dearer with each clone, attacker cost rising faster than identity count, like basalt under load. Honest agents show a real opal of diverse attributable trade; a saffron glow of payouts is no signal on its own.
